runtime: add portable KB launcher and capture leases

Use one standalone engine for checkout and packaged cluster commands. Private
versioned identities, prepared artifacts and fresh run receipts bind owned
resources to immutable source. Cold resume retains the accepted artifact;
updates prepare exact guest closures before stopping and preserve disks,
credentials and resolved SSH endpoints. Lifecycle contention refuses before
mutation. Unsupported legacy state remains untouched.

Capture and validation share explicit connection and artifact-root contracts.
Hold the artifact flock in the writing process through publication and
cleanup; cancel capture after lease loss. Prove administrator API and member
browser identities for the small inventory fixture. Keep committed media
validation as a separate strict hosted gate.

Bind readiness to the exact live run and discover all SSH keys within one
deadline without changing retained trust. Preserve child authority across
interruption. Give the runner its own session and retain its control listener,
tracker and reapers through one graceful shutdown. Notify accepted shutdown
even if its reply fails. Observe every process task and prove exit before
explicit machine cleanup and completion. Authenticated live shutdown may
retire only its pinned unchanged socket after complete exit; interruption
cannot reconstruct authority for a dead residual.

Forward non-terminal input through public SSH so piped scripts reach the
remote command. Terminal invocations remain noninteractive.

Pass machine-owned listening sockets to virtiofsd through its descriptor API
so ordinary shutdown leaves no daemon pidfiles. Pin socket and directory
identities through exact-path cleanup, keep OSVM daemon/reaper ownership, and
refuse old residues and replaced paths without adopting cleanup authority.

Qualify the installed public commands with one final-source cluster and
ordinary stop/resume. Allow 2 or 4 GiB per guest, with an 8 GiB services image
and root, and an 8 GiB tank; align image-builder RAM with the services
setting. Separate the 24 GiB output envelope from closures, staging and
retained-host reserves, and use assessed sequential memory peaks. These are
finite fit targets rather than proven minima. A new verifier campaign kind
refuses superseded roots and arguments without changing engine state formats.
Historical upgrades and two-instance proof remain deferred; native failure
ends the qualification.

Preserve resource-producer failures before formatting observations. Select
available inodes through the GNU df output field without conflicting flags,
and exercise the actual generated shell in the consuming verifier tests.

Observe the current process receipt as an authenticated append-only
publication during lease checks. Preserve every other retained file and claim
while allowing safe atomic replacement and its narrowly named unpublished
files. These observations grant no lifecycle authority.

Hold both runtime-fixture TCP probes through selection so ephemeral port reuse
cannot create duplicate SSH and HTTPS resource requests.

Persist each node's single Ed25519 host key on its retained tank after pool
and mount checks. Services and optional DNS retain the same single-key policy
on their writable roots. Volatile node roots must not regenerate identity on
resume, and one configured algorithm avoids partial multi-key discovery
without enlarging retained trust. Older artifacts receive no key migration.

Use the selected API 7.0 wire paths for inventory identities and fixture
actions. Check those paths before mock normalization, and refuse failed
actions with bounded method/path/status diagnostics that exclude credentials
and response bodies. Refuse non-200 before parsing and sanitize malformed
success envelopes so parser excerpts cannot enter public diagnostics.

Tune the single 2048/4096 MiB services workload with smaller SQL buffers, one
API worker and four nested PHP workers. Disable two metrics timers while
retaining their services and essential tasks. Other topologies retain their
inherited settings; the reduced limits still require a real fit check.

Honor an explicit short private TMPDIR for browser UNIX sockets while keeping
selected tools and environment scrubbing. Refuse unsafe temporary paths.

Accept an omitted member swap control only for a requested numeric zero, as
supplied by the pinned form submission. Preserve strict fixture resource
validation and refusal of missing or ambiguous required controls.

Use resource-namespaced GET filters and pagination limits for
fixture inventory. Unrelated primary associations and address rows must not
enter the dedicated pool selection or provisioning decisions.

Measure guest closure capacity with status-checked native df producers before
formatting values. Valid imports retain their byte and inode reserves;
failed producers cannot be hidden by a successful pipeline tail.

Accept the selected server's saved null or false non-primary association
while retaining literal false requests and strictly false pickability flags.
Model its save callback and reject malformed flags before address creation.

Keep the ordinary IP-list fixture on enabled networks. Validate retained
pools before association or address writes, preserve owned registration and
read-only reruns, and refuse incompatible old fixture identities. The capture
shows the assigned and detached addresses needed by member documentation.

runtime: add portable KB launcher and capture leases

Use one standalone engine for checkout and packaged cluster commands. Private
versioned identities, prepared artifacts and fresh run receipts bind owned
resources to immutable source. Cold resume retains the accepted artifact;
updates prepare exact guest closures before stopping and preserve disks,
credentials and resolved SSH endpoints. Lifecycle contention refuses before
mutation. Unsupported legacy state remains untouched.

Capture and validation share explicit connection and artifact-root contracts.
Hold the artifact flock in the writing process through publication and cleanup;
cancel capture after lease loss. Prove administrator API and member browser
identities for the small inventory fixture. Keep committed media validation
as a separate strict hosted gate.

Bind readiness to the exact live run and discover all SSH keys within one
deadline without changing retained trust. Preserve child authority across
interruption. Give the runner its own session and retain its control listener,
tracker and reapers through one graceful shutdown. Notify accepted shutdown
even if its reply fails. Observe every process task and prove exit before
explicit machine cleanup and completion. Authenticated live shutdown may
retire only its pinned unchanged socket after complete exit; interruption
cannot reconstruct authority for a dead residual.

Forward non-terminal input through public SSH so piped scripts reach the
remote command. Terminal invocations remain noninteractive.

Pass machine-owned listening sockets to virtiofsd through its descriptor API
so ordinary shutdown leaves no daemon pidfiles. Pin socket and directory
identities through exact-path cleanup, keep OSVM daemon/reaper ownership,
and refuse old residues and replaced paths without adopting cleanup authority.

Qualify the installed public commands with one final-source cluster and
ordinary stop/resume. Use two 2 GiB guests, an 8 GiB services image and root,
and an 8 GiB tank; align image-builder RAM with the services setting. Separate
the 24 GiB output envelope from closures, staging and retained-host reserves,
and use assessed sequential memory peaks. These are finite fit targets rather
than proven minima. A new verifier campaign kind refuses superseded roots and
arguments without changing engine state formats. Historical upgrades and
two-instance proof remain deferred; native failure ends the qualification.

Preserve resource-producer failures before formatting observations. Select
available inodes through the GNU df output field without conflicting flags,
and exercise the actual generated shell in the consuming verifier tests.

Observe the current process receipt as an authenticated append-only
publication during lease checks. Preserve every other retained file and
claim while allowing safe atomic replacement and its narrowly named
unpublished files. These observations grant no lifecycle authority.

Hold both runtime-fixture TCP probes through selection so ephemeral port
reuse cannot create duplicate SSH and HTTPS resource requests.

Persist each node's single Ed25519 host key on its retained tank after pool
and mount checks. Services and optional DNS retain the same single-key policy
on their writable roots. Volatile node roots must not regenerate identity
on resume, and one configured algorithm avoids partial multi-key discovery
without enlarging retained trust. Older artifacts receive no key migration.

Use the selected API 7.0 wire paths for inventory identities and fixture
actions. Check those paths before mock normalization, and refuse failed
actions with bounded method/path/status diagnostics that exclude credentials
and response bodies.
Refuse non-200 before parsing and sanitize malformed success envelopes so
parser excerpts cannot enter public diagnostics.

Use one standalone engine for checkout and packaged cluster commands. Private
versioned identities, prepared artifacts and fresh run receipts bind owned
resources to immutable source and full-lifetime capture leases. Cold resume
retains the accepted artifact; updates prepare exact guest closures before
stopping and preserve owned disks and credentials. Require unchanged resolved
SSH endpoints so retained host-key trust remains valid after the restart.
Public lifecycle contention refuses before mutation rather than queuing it.

Capture and validation share explicit connection and artifact-root contracts,
with canonical source proof and bilingual result preservation. Keep the
artifact flock in the writing process through publication and cleanup so a
helper failure cannot admit a competing writer during synchronous writes.
Observed lease loss cancels capture and prevents subsequent publication.

Verify the installed tools directly on an ordinary Linux/Nix/KVM host through
public commands, with exact predecessor continuity and measured capacity.
The selected IP inventory fixture uses a small member VPS and dedicated
administrator API provisioning while retaining a proved member browser.
Expose a separate strict hosted check for the accepted committed media.

Discover all machine SSH keys within one readiness deadline, retaining private
native diagnostics and refusing partial or changed trust. Preserve child PID
authority atomically across supported interruption and close owned resources.
Give the runner its
own POSIX session before machine creation; containing cgroup and host failures
still require complete ownership and exit proof. Quiesce its control thread
before closing the listener, and preserve primary fixture failures and native
private diagnostics without accepting unknown socket contents.

Pin the private directory and socket inode during authenticated live shutdown.
The same locked stop or update may retire only that unchanged control socket
after acknowledged shutdown and complete exit proof for the same launch and
runner. The verifier uses final-controller stop, genuine predecessor resume
and final-controller update. Interruption discards this permission; a dead
residual cannot reconstruct it from saved path or inode facts.

Legacy state and sockets remain untouched rather than being adopted by the
new engine.
